AEIR Affiliate Program

 About Our Brand and Products

AEIR is a performance and recovery company focused on bringing advanced CO₂ therapy into everyday life. Our products are designed for athletes, high performers, and health-conscious individuals who want to recover faster, support circulation, and feel their best.

Our core products include the Full Body Flex Suit, a wearable CO₂ therapy system designed for full-body recovery, and our CO₂ Renew line, topical CO₂-based formulations that support skin health and circulation. Together, they create a simple but powerful at-home recovery experience.


 What Makes Us Different

AEIR combines science-backed CO₂ therapy with thoughtful product design to make professional-grade recovery accessible at home.

We focus on:

  • Non-invasive, drug-free recovery support

  • Premium, durable product design

  • Simple, repeatable recovery routines

  • Education-driven content for long-term wellness

Our goal is not quick fixes, but consistent performance and recovery over time.



How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn 5% commission on all sales generated through their unique link or code.

  • Commission applies to all qualifying purchases

  • No cap on earnings

  • Paid on verified, completed orders

The more you share, the more you earn.



How to Promote Us

Affiliates succeed by sharing authentic experiences and education. Examples include:

  • Demonstrating your recovery routine

  • Sharing before/after use cases

  • Explaining the benefits of CO₂ therapy

  • Posting on social media, blogs, newsletters, or YouTube

  • Referring clients, teams, or communities

Content that is honest, educational, and experience-based performs best.



 Other Information

  • We encourage truthful, responsible claims

  • Affiliates must represent the brand professionally

  • We provide product education and support resources

  • Ideal partners include coaches, trainers, clinics, and wellness advocates

AEIR is building a community around better recovery and long-term performance. If that aligns with your audience, we’d love to have you as a partner.



Safety & Responsible Use

AEIR products are designed as non-invasive wellness and recovery tools. We prioritize thoughtful design, quality materials, and responsible use.

Affiliates should always promote AEIR products accurately and avoid making medical or disease-related claims. Customers should follow product instructions and consult a healthcare professional if they have medical concerns.

Our focus is supporting recovery, circulation, and overall wellness — not diagnosing or treating medical conditions.
